title: Thousands of horses caught up in Europe-wide trafficking scheme
content_md: Europol has supported a major operation against a criminal network suspected of trafficking horses across Europe using falsified documents and manipulated microchips to conceal the animals’ true identities. Article Link: Thousands of horses caught up in Europe-wide trafficking scheme – Fraudulent passports and manipulated microchips used to disguise horses’ identities, with animals potentially diverted into the food chain | Europol
exclude_reason: Europol horse trafficking operation; traditional law enforcement, not cyber
